name: Type-1 Direct Connection Algorithm
definition: Algorithm to compute a refractive path between a vertex $\mathbf{y}$ on a medium boundary (defined by implicit surface $g(\cdot)=0$) and a vertex $\mathbf{x}_0$ inside the medium, by optimizing the initial velocity $\mathbf{v}_0$.
summary: The Type-1 Direct Connection Algorithm computes a refractive light path between an internal vertex and a boundary vertex by optimizing initial velocity, distinguished by its use of explicit geometric boundary constraints for faster convergence.
